knowledge_gaps: The treatment equals the control for histories of 3–12 events because every eligible nonterminal target is in the recent-ten window. Histories of two events also behave identically. Report training-user sampling mass with history length above 12; otherwise the intervention may have little effective exposure.

Reproducibility remains incomplete: the report does not specify the actual checkpoint-selection rule, evaluation schedule, epoch allocation, integer RNG purpose IDs, or measured compute allocation across the eight category fits required for two arms.

The CE helpers leave full versus sampled softmax, candidate construction, accidental-positive handling, and exclusion of padding/MASK output classes unspecified. These must match across arms and preserve the supplied control objective.

Skipping short histories while retaining unchanged user sampling needs an explicit shared rule. Resampling users, dropping examples, and skipping optimizer updates produce different training distributions and update counts.

Originality 3 is reasonable, but the literature comparison omits closely related recency-based target and subsequence sampling. Difficulty 3 describes the sampler edit; complete integration and comparison remain unverified. Future potential 6 is provisional without eligible-history coverage and paired validation results.

The bootstrap specification should retain its limitations: uncertainty is conditional on fitted models and fixed candidates, excludes training variability, and does not correct adaptive checkpoint or configuration selection. Sampled HR@10 also cannot establish full-catalog recommendation quality.
